findings.governingReading: 力を抜く asks whether he should cease exerting force and let the chain pull him so Gilgamesh falls too.
findings.explanation: Stopping his resistance becomes casually loosening up.

findings.highlight: melts this era's version of his body.
findings.evidenceJa: この時代に現れた彼の体を透かしていく
findings.governingReading: The ending permeates him and makes the body manifested in this era transparent.
findings.explanation: Archer's body becoming translucent becomes melting.

findings.evidenceJa: とことん甘くなくては張り合いがない
findings.governingReading: 甘くなくては張り合いがない says her realism must coexist with thorough softheartedness/sweetness for her to be herself to Archer.

findings.highlight: Please take care of me. I am an unreliable guy, as you know.
findings.evidenceJa: 私を頼む。知っての通り頼りないヤツだからな
findings.governingReading: 私を頼む deliberately overlaps Archer with the distant boy, then immediately identifies that unreliable guy as the one Rin must support.
findings.explanation: Archer entrusting his other self to Rin becomes asking care for the present Archer.

findings.evidenceJa: 他人事のように、騎士は言った
findings.governingReading: 他人事のように marks Archer's distancing: he talks about his own other self as though it were another person's affair.
findings.explanation: Speaking as if it concerned someone else becomes speaking objectively.

findings.governingReading: ざあ names the audible rush at the instant Archer disappears.
findings.explanation: A rushing sound becomes a breeze.
